name: femenu-load-exit
purpose: iter-463 custom_frontend steps 4-5 (docs/CUSTOM_FRONTEND.md 10, 'Menu v1' + 'Exit'): title -> START -> MAIN MENU -> DOWN, A = LOAD GAME (the game's own slot picker / no-save handling; the roll's save root is fresh and empty unless SR_CONTENT_DIR seeds one) -> B = BootFlowLoadCanceled, the game re-raises LOAD A GAME? and the menu comes back -> DOWN x3, Enter (keyboard START mapped to A) = EXIT -> Esc (pad BACK mapped to B) cancels the confirm -> A = EXIT again -> DOWN, A = YES -> fscommand SR_Quit -> the process exits through the window-close path. The last step is the pass condition: exit code 0 within 2 s (sr_drive expectExitCode); a crash on exit or a hang fails the roll. Run with -Gates SR_MODS=custom_frontend. -TimeoutSeconds 420.

steps.name: load-observe
steps.purpose: Capture window: the game's own LOAD path on an empty save root.

steps.name: down-to-exit
steps.purpose: MAIN MENU = NEW GAME / LOAD GAME / OPTIONS / MODS / EXIT since the modmenu lane

steps.name: exit-clean
steps.purpose: PASS condition: the process ends with exit code 0 within 2 s of SR_Quit (docs/CUSTOM_FRONTEND.md 10 'Exit'). A crash code or a process still running fails the roll.
